# `mise tool-stubs remove`

- **Usage:** `mise tool-stubs remove [--into <DIR>] [-f --force] <MANIFEST>`
- **Effect:** destructive — may delete or irreversibly overwrite
- **Source code:** [`src/cli/tool_stubs.rs`](https://github.com/jdx/mise/blob/main/src/cli/tool_stubs.rs)

Remove command files owned by a synchronized bundle

## Arguments
- **`<MANIFEST>`** — Path to the tool-stub bundle manifest

## Flags
- **`--into <DIR>`** — Directory containing the commands (normally discovered from prior sync state)
- **`-f --force`** — Remove owned command files even when their contents were modified
- **`-h --help`** — Print help
